name: The Sea Has Teeth
description:
Fen's crews can sail farther now, but something vast is following them beyond the harbor lights.

Defeat one Ice and Fire sea serpent. Choose terrain that gives you a chance to recover. Defeat the named boss once; tracked earlier kills may count.

Legacy commendation: a victory or advancement earned on another story path can satisfy this record. This does not create a separate instance of the encounter.
